verdict.rationale: Runpod provides a REST API (v1), an open-source CLI (runpodctl) for scriptable management of Pods/Serverless/volumes, and Serverless endpoints with pay-per-second billing that are natively designed for automated, non-interactive invocation — all suitable for CI/headless pipelines. Instant Clusters and templates further support scripted, non-interactive job deployment without manual UI steps. Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD integration examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), no independent hands-on account of running Runpod fully headlessly in a pipeline.
